title: Cross-GPU throughput & cost harness: A10 / L4 / A100 / H100 matrix
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a repeatable, automated harness to measure tokens/sec, p95 latency, and cost-per-token across target GPUs (NVIDIA A10, L4, A100, H100). The harness must support both synthetic prompt sets and replayed production traces, emit standardized metrics for regression detection, and feed results into the Console cost dashboards and the infra SLO alerting pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end harness that runs nightly across A10/L4/A100/H100 with identical workload configs
Metrics exported to Prometheus & exported CSV: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latencies, GPU util, mem, batch size distribution, KV cache hit rate, cost-per-token estimate
Automated regression detection: compare last-night vs baseline and open ENG ticket on >5% p95 regression or >8% cost increase
Results land in runtime-1.20 release dashboard and Console 'hardware-cost-matrix' view
Test artifacts: raw logs, condensed CSV, summary HTML with heatmap and recommendations
test_plan: 1) Workloads: small-chat (seq=256), medium-chat (seq=1024), long-context (seq=4096), embeddings (avg len 64). 2) Models: gptx-small (FP16), gptx-medium (INT8), rwx-compat variants to stress kernel selector. 3) Modes: single-request, continuous-streaming, batched-64, batched-adaptive. 4) Run each workload 30x per GPU to capture variability; collect token-level timing and per-request traces. 5) Replayed traces: two 24-hour slices from production (anonymized) to validate real traffic behavior. 6) Cost calc: use cloud unit GPU-hour rates + amortized infra (network/storage) to compute cost/token and cost/1k tokens for each GPU and mode.
implementation_notes: Harness implemented as a set of Dockerized runners that spawn the runtime with pinned kernel flags. Uses our existing perf-agent for measurement and a new adapter to convert perf-agent output into prom-compatible metrics (labels: gpu_type, model_tag, batch_size, seq_len, quant_mode). The runner supports 'baseline' and 'candidate' tags to enable A/B comparisons. We reuse existing KV-cache priming scripts and candlestick tracer. Harness runs in a dedicated 'bench' namespace to avoid quota interference.
results_summary: Preliminary nightly run (2026-03-11) shows expected ordering of raw tokens/sec: L4 > A10 (for small seq, batched workloads), H100 > A100 on high-seq workloads due to kernel tiling; INT8 quantized variants reduce cost/token 28-36% on average but add 6-12% p95 tail. Cost-per-1k tokens (cloud list rates used): A10: $0.95, L4: $0.84, A100: $1.45, H100: $1.92 for baseline FP16 medium-chat. Notable regression: candidate kernel selector flag 'use-tiling-v2' increased p95 by 9% on A100 for long-context; we've annotated and will roll back in next run. Full CSV and dashboard links in artifacts.
detailed_findings: Batching sensitivity: tokens/sec scales sublinearly beyond batch=128 on L4 due to PCIe limits observed; p95 increases when batch >256
KV cache hit effectiveness: for replayed traces with 40% prefix reuse, tokens/sec improved by 1.8x and cost/token dropped ~42% on H100 compared to cold-cache runs
Quantization tradeoffs: INT8 yields best cost reduction on A10/L4; on H100 the bespoke FP8 path is promising but needs kernel tuning
Regression detection: current threshold triggered for 'use-tiling-v2' on A100; automatic ticket created ENG-9481 for rollback investigation
actions: Disable 'use-tiling-v2' for A100 staged runs and re-run nightly suite (assigned Diego)
Add KV cache priming option to replay harness to measure warm/cold delta systematically (owner: Priya Rao)
Instrument cost calc to include amortized autoscaler overhead for Dedicated pools (owner: finance-infra sync)
Publish hardware-cost-matrix report to Console and Slack #infra-weekly when nightly completes without regressions
